about.title: From Physical Therapy to software engineering for healthcare
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack Developer working with React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript and Go. I build intuitive, responsive interfaces and robust, scalable APIs, always keeping an eye on performance, process automation and cost reduction.
about.p2: Today I work at Mobilemed Soluções Médicas, on the cloud PACS and teleradiology platform used by clinics and hospitals. Before that, I led web development at Biointegral Saúde Clinic, where I built an e-commerce platform from scratch, financial and patient-flow systems, and tools that cut operating costs by 15%.
about.p3: I come from Physical Therapy, which gave me empathy for the people who use the product, team leadership and attention to detail. I have international experience in France and the United States and speak English (C1) and French (B2), which makes working with global teams easier.
about.softSkills: Leadership · Problem solving · Teamwork · Communication · Scrum · Kanban

biointegral.description: Led the clinic's web development with React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js and TypeScript: an e-commerce platform built from scratch, financial and patient-flow systems and tools that doubled the team's productivity, with a 15% reduction in operating costs. In parallel, I worked as a physiotherapist in the integrative physiotherapy department.
